prior_summary: Hole-frame SE(3) action and observation coordinates make transport, staging, descent and early insertion targets move with the freshly observed hole pose while retaining measured Panda configuration.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when hole_pose is reliable and the fixture has moved relative to training, the fingers remain closed, two frames indicate peg/TCP coupling, and the transformed path appears reachable.
termination_guidance: Continue until the peg is near hole-axis alignment, y/z centered and descending toward hole height; transfer to align_and_insert_peg anywhere in the retained [1380,1500) overlap when successor readiness is observable.
limitations: Hole-frame equivariance does not guarantee reachability, collision avoidance, contact, or recovery. It is weak for a displaced/slipping peg with an unchanged hole and for obstacle arrangements that do not move with the hole.
